details: Bitcoin climbed above $65,000 after the July U.S. jobs report revealed an unexpected decline of 23,000 nonfarm payrolls, significantly missing forecasts. This data weakened the case for another Federal Reserve interest rate hike, leading traders to lower their expectations for a September increase. Following the news, Bitcoin rose almost 2% to approximately $65,200.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $65K as Unexpected US Jobs Decline Eases Rate Hike Fears

details: BTCPay Server has disclosed a critical vulnerability that is being actively exploited, urging users to update their servers to version 2.4.2 immediately. The payment processor warned that failure to update or temporarily shut down servers could lead to unauthorized access and potential loss of funds. The Bitcoin Red Team reportedly identified this flaw.
title: BTCPay Server Warns of Critical Vulnerability Actively Exploited, Urges Immediate Update

details: Trump Media and Technology Group (TMTG) and Crypto.com have realigned their previously announced prediction market integration. Instead of direct development on Truth Social, the companies will now pursue a marketing agreement to promote Crypto.com's prediction market experiences to Truth Social users. TMTG's interim CEO stated this shift better aligns with their strategic focus on revenue and their pending merger.
title: Trump Media & Crypto.com Pivot Prediction Market Integration to Marketing Deal

details: The United States has imposed sanctions on two additional Iranian cryptocurrency exchanges as part of its ongoing "Economic Fury" campaign. This action aims to disrupt illicit financial activities and reinforces global regulatory efforts against entities suspected of circumventing international sanctions.
title: US Sanctions Two More Iranian Crypto Exchanges in 'Economic Fury' Campaign

details: Joseph Chalom, CEO of SharpLink, has formally opposed Ethereum Improvement Proposal (EIP-8363), a draft proposal that suggests burning validator rewards as staking increases. Chalom argued that this measure would negatively impact the decentralized finance (DeFi) ecosystem by raising capital costs and potentially diverting activity away from Ethereum, thereby eroding one of its key advantages over Bitcoin and hindering institutional adoption.
title: SharpLink CEO Criticizes Ethereum EIP-8363, Warns of DeFi Harm

details: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has issued a warning to regulated prediction market platforms, advising them against displaying contracts using American-style gambling odds (e.g., +150 or -200). The CFTC reiterated that these platforms function as financial exchanges governed by derivatives laws and must avoid deceptive marketing practices that could confuse them with traditional sports betting operations.
title: CFTC Warns Prediction Markets Against Using Gambling-Style Odds

details: The U.S. Senate has postponed a vote on the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (CLARITY Act) until September, pushing this significant crypto market structure legislation beyond the August recess. The delay is attributed to ongoing disagreements over ethics provisions related to federal officials' cryptocurrency holdings and unresolved issues concerning stablecoin regulations.
title: US Senate Delays CLARITY Act Vote Until September Recess

details: Coinbase has suspended LRC-USD trading pairs, effective August 7, 2026, which effectively closes its dollar market for Loopring. This decision, part of Coinbase's routine asset review process, means that while user balances remain accessible, liquidity for LRC may be limited, especially given reports that Loopring's decentralized exchange is no longer operational.
title: Coinbase Suspends Loopring (LRC) Trading Pairs, Users Advised to Seek Alternatives

details: Bitcoin miner MARA Holdings sold 91.37% of its mined Bitcoin in the second quarter and subsequently secured $600 million in new debt by pledging 18,750 BTC. This financing, obtained from Coinbase Credit and Two Prime Lending, will support MARA's planned acquisition of a power-generation site for AI and high-performance computing initiatives. However, questions have been raised regarding the reconciliation of the collateral pools.
title: MARA Sells Most Mined Bitcoin, Pledges 18,750 BTC for AI Expansion

details: US-listed spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) experienced robust inflows, pulling in $244.4 million in net new capital on Wednesday. This marked a three-day streak of positive inflows, accumulating to over $626 million. BlackRock's IBIT led these gains, attracting $479 million over the three-day period and pushing its cumulative net inflows to nearly $61 billion.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Strong Inflows, Attracting $244M in a Single Day
